reviews.disposition:
F1: Full cumulative content review is complete for this owner. B556/B557/B558/B559 actually read original1–500/501–1000/1001–1500/1501–1900; B560 reads original1901–2087 and all appended2088–2147. Original2087-line prefix SHA256399b5c7097bfcea954579e19d7d054eb814a7de1ec265ac01e4eeac9bd766d1b matches B556 exactly. Every row/qualifier in this owner is reviewed, not every linked source/game/lane report or current runtime behavior.

F2: FT1–FT5 correct earlier summaries: doctrine policy versus persistent design capability, derived era versus soft early cost versus hard prerequisite, historical taskmaster versus a proposed idle adaptation, later conditional build order, and actor knowledge's existing stage/value/time/cause/basis owner. Extend that actual owner for a selected evidence consumer instead of adding IM2's proposed second store. FT6–FT8 retain donor limits: unlock/source/bench/subject study and usable knowledge do not prove revisable uncertainty, portable apparatus/fuel or guaranteed taught mastery. No need to reintroduce an empty evidence-owner question from the opening schema.

F3: CA8–CA11 are recorded direction under AD32: direct investigation from available means, discovered and proposed goals, useful alternatives retaining the original objective, and usable imperfect prototypes within their limits. They do not select free-text UI, live model, arbitrary invention success or every factory/framework. Failed hypothesis/procedure, inconclusive finding, working partial and side discovery differ. Research need not be a timer; actual use can give evidence without a guaranteed upgrade. Stronger means can remove normal dependencies. Existing setup is not automatically retrofitted by learning, and independent confirmation is not manufactured from repeated dependent citations.

F4: Current routing already records T6/T16 pure support merged, B1 historical native U40/N19 delivery, B2 fixtures, B3 inspector design, B5 conditional prompts, removed two worktrees and restored source provenance. Old started/unmerged/push/cleanup/first-slice recommendations are history, not a current execution queue or authorization. The broad opening nothing-implemented statement cannot erase selected native delivery. CN14's old wait-for-acceptance wording was superseded within this owner; current AD42/AD51 and PROJECT determine review/sequencing, with no new Frontier depth implied. Retained historical source and original ideas should not be deleted to make a short status summary.

F5: MCW1–MCW8 remain proposals with named triggers. Tier can govern a specific capability rather than every property. Exchange-derived and authored prices can intentionally yield arbitrage without anti-exploit correction. Source-supported upkeep shortfall can stop, degrade or affect another carrier, but mandatory health/nausea/cost is not inferred. Water/thirst/temperature work stays deferred, and regional reputation, quest policy inheritance, seasonal fertility and material-generated families need their actual owner/clock/reader before use. No second timer, universal binary fertility or compulsory reputation bleed follows from the examples.

F6: Existing B393/B395/B399 folds preserve full checkpoint/report and22-roadmap review scopes, graph D/W/N arithmetic versus actual elapsed feasibility, target identity versus functional substitute and distinct source/cue/provenance/custody evidence. Their earlier reviews are attributed; this full owner read does not newly revalidate their source/game facts or passing checks. Current AD8/AD16/AD22/AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 qualify old blanket precision, pause, balance, verification, consumer and compression claims. No implementation, source acquisition, private save, browser/build, model/worker, migration, deletion, worktree move, stage/commit or push occurred. Continue the wider intake; full owner coverage does not close its proposed gameplay backlog.
